fusions.name: Startled Updraft
fusions.desc: Bursts into a gust that deals 12 wind damage to everything 4 tiles ahead and knocks it 3 tiles back. Your movement speed then rises by 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Long Glide
fusions.desc: Glides at an enemy up to 7 tiles away and deals 4 wind damage, rising to 1.5 times that at 7 tiles.

fusions.name: Borne Aloft
fusions.desc: Leaps to a point up to 7 tiles away, and your movement speed rises by 15% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Light on the Hoof
fusions.desc: Your movement speed rises by 10%. You resist wind damage by 8%.
